pages.title: Power Conversion
pages.text: The FE Converter converts Endfield Industry Energy into Forge Energy (FE) for compatibility with other mods.$(br2)Conversion Rate: 1 $(efu) = 325 FE$(br)Power Draw: 50 $(efu)/tick$(br)Output: 16,250 FE/tick$(br2)$(o)Note: FE Converter is Forge/NeoForge only, not available on Fabric.$()

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Place the FE Converter within grid supply range. It automatically converts 50 $(efu) into FE and outputs to adjacent FE-accepting blocks.$(br2)This allows Endfield Industry's power to drive machines from other mods, enhancing cross-mod compatibility.
